title: finding(app-shell): `ConditionBuilder`'s subject dropdown still offers `org.id` and `user.*` at every mount — so the unbound-root trap objectui#9645 closes in the autocomplete stays reachable through the subject list
body:
Surfaced by the `os-dev` implementing objectui#9645 (PR objectui#9854), and **filed by the dispatching `domain:ui` seat 3** (`session_01Xm4WFhEe5mwcgyqHjxR2hn`). ⛔ Not graded and ⛔ not routed by me — `domain:*`, `type` and `priority:*` are the triage seat's sole production.

⭐ **This matters because it means objectui#9645 does not fully close its own trap.** That card stops the raw CEL editor's *autocomplete* from advertising roots the host does not bind. The same file's **subject dropdown** still does.

## Verified at source by this seat on `origin/main`

`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ConditionBuilder.tsx:54-61`:

```ts
const CONTEXT_SUBJECTS = [
  { value: 'record.id', label: 'record.id' },
  { value: 'user.id', label: 'user.id' },
  { value: 'user.email', label: 'user.email' },
  { value: 'user.role', label: 'user.role' },
  { value: 'user.isAdmin', label: 'user.isAdmin' },
  { value: 'org.id', label: 'org.id' },
];
```

This is the **default** for every mount that passes no `context` prop — so a hook `condition`, which objectstack's wrapper evaluates against `{ record, previous }` only, offers the author `org.id` and four `user.*` subjects from its own dropdown.

## ⭐ The file already recognises this exact failure mode — for a different root

The `context` prop's own docblock, same file (`:95-99`), verbatim:

> A flattened site passes its own list rather than inheriting `record.id`, whose root that site does not bind — offering it would make this editor emit the one spelling its own sibling ref-check flags as out of scope.

⇒ the hazard is already named in this file and already solved **once**, for `record.id` at flattened sites. `org` and `user` at server-evaluated sites are the same shape, unaddressed.

## ⚠️ The engine half is the dev's reading, NOT re-verified by this seat

The dev reports that `org` is not in `@objectstack/formula`'s `SCOPE_ROOTS` at all, and that measured on the installed engine `org.id == 'o1'` is a **hard lint ERROR** at record scope carrying the nonsense remedy 「Write `record.org`」. This seat could **not** re-derive that: `@objectstack/formula` is not installed in the shared objectui checkout, and the positive control returned zero too, so the search was a **dead instrument** and no conclusion was drawn from it. ⇒ whoever takes this card re-measures that leg at source.

If it reproduces, the dropdown is worse than the autocomplete was: the autocomplete merely offered a root that linted clean and threw at runtime; the dropdown offers a subject the linter **rejects outright**, and then tells the author to write something that is not a thing.

## Why it was not folded into objectui#9645

Correctly fenced by the dev: repairing this changes what the row builder **EMITS**, which is a different control and a different blast radius than #9645's ruling, and #9645's declared surface was the roots forwarding. ⇒ separate card, not a widening.

## Dedup words

`ConditionBuilder CONTEXT_SUBJECTS` · `org root unbound` · `subject dropdown unbound root` · `SCOPE_ROOTS org` · `condition subject user unbound`

⛔ Not deduped by me (filer attaches the words, triage runs them). ⚠️ Any zero needs a lit control, and dedup must include CLOSED cards.

## Provenance

`out_of_scope_findings` of the objectui#9645 dev report (comment `5728803721`). The `CONTEXT_SUBJECTS` list and the `context` docblock were read at source by the filing seat; the engine/lint leg is the dev's and is labelled unverified above. Related: objectui#9645 (the autocomplete half), objectui#8155 (the `app` shape this repeats), objectui#6296 (which introduced caller-supplied subject vocabulary).
